sol2f.gui.config.title: Spice of Life: Fabric Flavor Settings
sol2f.gui.config.option.health.maxHealth: The maximum health gain belonging to this mod, not including other mods and default health.
sol2f.gui.config.option.health.healthGai: Health gain per discovered food (set to 0 to disable).
sol2f.gui.config.option.health.resetOnDe: When enabled, player health resets to default upon death.
sol2f.gui.config.option.health.healthToM: Restores full health each time the player's maximum health increases.
sol2f.gui.config.option.health.healthInc: Restores health each time maximum health increases. If greater than max, restores to max.
sol2f.gui.config.option.health.Expressio: Custom health calculation expression (if 0, equivalent to disabled).
Tip: To use only the expression, set the original health gain to 0 and set the frequency gain frequency to 0.
This configuration works independently. Even if the expression is available, the original simple health configuration still takes effect.
Please check the guide on the modrinth mod page.
sol2f.gui.config.option.health.blacklist: Items in the list will not be recorded. Consumed items will not be removed from statistics.
After modification, use /sol2f sync AllFoodList to sync data to ensure tooltip displays correctly.
Enter one item ID per line, for example: minecraft:golden_apple
sol2f.gui.config.option.dev.developerMod: Enables developer-specific features and debug information. For any feedback, it is recommended to enable this option and reproduce the issue, then export runtime logs via the launcher to report to the author.
sol2f.gui.config.option.hunger.EnableNat: When enabled, player loses hunger points over time.
sol2f.gui.config.option.hunger.NaturalHu: Time interval between natural hunger loss (in ticks).
Custom expression for natural hunger loss calculation, calculates saturation decay rather than directly applying as saturation.
Please check the guide on the modrinth mod page.
sol2f.gui.config.option.hunger.EnableSle: When enabled, player loses hunger points upon waking from sleep.
sol2f.gui.config.option.hunger.SleepHung: Custom expression for sleep hunger loss calculation.
Please check the guide on the modrinth mod page.
sol2f.gui.config.option.hunger.MinFoodLe: The minimum food level that natural hunger and sleep hunger can reduce to.
sol2f.gui.config.option.hunger.ShowNotic: Sends a notice message to the player when hunger falls below this value.
sol2f.gui.config.option.food.@Notice: [NOTICE] The options on this page are experimental. It is recommended to wait for the next stable release. For any issues, please contact the author via email on the Modrinth page. See "Changelog" for detailed feature descriptions (features will not be documented in the guide before official release). This version has not yet been adapted for AppleSkin display. Stay tuned for the official release.
sol2f.gui.config.option.food.EnableNutri: When enabled, the nutrition value of food will be modified according to the configuration.
sol2f.gui.config.option.food.NutritionEx: Custom expression for food nutrition calculation.
Please refer to the [Changelog] for this version on Modrinth for guidance (before the official release).
sol2f.gui.config.option.food.RecentShort: The size of the recent short list. Short-term food records exceeding this range will be removed.
sol2f.gui.config.option.food.RecentLongL: The size of the recent long list. Long-term food records exceeding this range will be removed.
sol2f.gui.config.option.food.BlackList.@: Items in this list will not be modified.
